Even before your senses adjust, you recognize the kami of
the Castle of the Taro Clan.

You see the standard of your teki, Ashikaga Takauji, flying above
the town.  How could such a thing have happened?  Why are ninja
wandering freely; where are the samurai of your daimyo, Lord Sato?

You quickly say a prayer to Izanagi and Izanami and walk towards
town.

comment: Debug-mode lawful Samurai steps off the stairs, wishes a chaotic altar and a white unicorn corpse that drops onto it, and offers the corpse: sacrificing a co-aligned unicorn on a cross-aligned altar sets the record to -1, so Susanowo accepts his allegiance and he is permanently converted. He then level-teleports to the quest home through the debug menu, wishes a helm of opposite alignment and tries to wear it; accessory_or_armor_on() refuses it in the quest with the converted-hero message (do_wear.c:2232-2233). Independent seed, date and character.
